    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C#/.NET/.NET Core优秀项目和框架2026年1月简报</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202602/1336199-20260209033248921-1804928154.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>前言</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>公众号每月定期推广和分享的C#/.NET/.NET Core优秀项目和框架（每周至少会推荐两个优秀的项目和框架当然节假日除外），公众号推文中有项目和框架的详细介绍、功能特点、使用方式以及部分功能截图等（打不开或者打开GitHub很慢的同学可以优先查看公众号推文，文末一定会附带项目和框架源码地址）。注意：排名不分先后，都是十分优秀的开源项目和框架，每周定期更新分享<span>。</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>💡简报Gitee开源地址：https://gitee.com/ysgdaydayup/DotNetGuide/blob/main/docs/DotNet/DotNetProjectMonthly.md</strong></li>
<li><strong>🔔简报GitHub开源地址：https://github.com/YSGStudyHards/DotNetGuide/blob/main/docs/DotNet/DotNetProjectMonthly.md</strong></li>
</ul>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>PicView</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;PicView 是一款基于 .NET Avalonia 的开源免费、快速、可高度定制、跨平台的图片查看器，支持 macOS 和 Windows 10/11 操作系统。它支持几乎所有常见的图像文件类型，包括但不限于 (animated)WEBP、(animated)GIF、SVG、AVIF、HEIC、PSD 等，为用户提供了一个清洁、无干扰且高效的图片浏览体验。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/Ruben2776/PicView</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247519624&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=e56244d916a38bac360c8d68a20e98ba&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/eFQoxqJqbpQAPGpVaXd6Wg</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202602/1336199-20260209033332545-692836293.png" alt="image" width="992" height="662" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202602/1336199-20260209033338128-491859439.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>NanUI</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;NanUI 是一个基于 .NET 平台的开源（MIT License）框架，旨在帮助开发者使用 HTML5、CSS3 和 JavaScript 构建具有现代感的 WinForm 应用程序用户界面。它底层依托于 Xilium.CefGlue 这是 Chromium Embedded Framework（CEF）在 .NET 环境下的官方绑定实现，通过嵌入完整的 Chromium 渲染引擎，使 WinForm 应用能够呈现 Web 技术驱动的富交互界面。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://gitee.com/dotnetchina/NanUI</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247519598&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=bbed5ac97e8a2785253bd2368450e118&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/2PDN5Q31wX6vEctodVKcig</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202602/1336199-20260203225205762-1526989538.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202602/1336199-20260203225210743-1010420250.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Generative-AI-for-beginners-dotnet</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;Generative-AI-for-beginners-dotnet 是一个微软官方开源且实用课程，教你如何在.NET 中构建生成式人工智能应用。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/microsoft/Generative-AI-for-beginners-dotnet</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247519543&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=6b0215e4eb92c7f58949203bfe37f339&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/zy16qmxDPbxovRwHvKae6g</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202602/1336199-20260209033425607-155706794.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>XAML Studio</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;XAML Studio 是一款专为 WinUI XAML 设计的快速原型设计工具，基于 C# 开源（MIT license），生成的代码可轻松复制到 Visual Studio 中的应用中。XAML Studio 让你实时预览 XAML 代码，并与结果互动，就像它在你自己的应用中运行一样。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/dotnet/XAMLStudio</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247519483&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=9ec36931cf81fe24ebf0e7adca87cf45&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/Kf_MrpoC-I7UbhmUNLusow</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202602/1336199-20260209033437399-1610670320.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202602/1336199-20260209033441885-1422987054.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Codist</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;Codist 是一个使用 .NET 编写、开源免费的 Visual Studio 扩展插件，致力于为 C# 程序员提供更好的编程体验和生产效率。它不仅强化了语法高亮、快速信息提示、导航栏、滚动条和显示质量，还集成了自动版本号更新、括号自动补全、支持高级编辑功能的智能工具栏、代码分析等功能。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/wmjordan/Codist</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247519381&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=e0b740e201c1c5ec07a63fa5878f50fd&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/UWuCIY4Q5PJeNClrQWPGEw</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202602/1336199-20260209033453999-214604184.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>PropertyTools</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;PropertyTools 是一款开源（MIT license）、免费的 WPF 自定义控件集，该控件集涵盖了 PropertyGrid、DataGrid、支持多选的 TreeView、ColorPicker 等常用控件。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://github.com/PropertyTools/PropertyTools</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247519334&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=e163b6f037627858c7ddd0fa8befb76b&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/fLsTZWyY1W7UFJWCmIa4mQ</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202602/1336199-20260209033506338-4677782.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202602/1336199-20260209033510793-693271895.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>WMES</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;WMES 是一套基于 ASP.NET 6.0 MVC + SqlSugar + LayUI 的框架，源代码完全开源。该系统旨在帮助企业解决 C#.NET 项目的重复工作，提高开发效率，节省人力成本，同时保持高度的灵活性。系统支持多数据库类型，模块化设计，层次结构清晰，内置一系列企业信息管理的基础功能。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong><span>&nbsp;https://gitee.com/bzh/wmes</span></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247519136&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=cb3f96af366d1c6c6e039ba33369a559&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/sYCB90ss0sRiOS17F-fdhg</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202602/1336199-20260209033523835-67847044.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202602/1336199-20260209033528796-56018905.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
